Plantoir 1.3.2 is for the Mac. **Windows: no changes** — the Windows download stays at 1.3.1 on plantoir.app until it catches up. Plantoir 1.4.0 or later on the Mac will offer this update by itself.

**New**

- Plantoir finds its own new versions and asks before installing one. (macOS)
- Scheduled publishes now tell you how they went. See [the support page](https://plantoir.app/support.html).
- Course Settings opens faster on large courses. (Windows)

**Improved**

- The sidebar remembers which courses you folded away.

**Fixed**

- A page named with `brackets` no longer hides its neighbours.
